The notification includes 284 fixed-number vacancies through AFCAT and GATE Score Entry, along with NCC Special Entry seats determined by the prescribed percentage of Flying Branch vacancies. Candidates with relevant graduation, engineering or postgraduate qualifications can apply according to branch-specific eligibility requirements. T

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 1 2027 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The AFCAT written examination will be held on 31 January 2027, from 10:00 AM to 12:00 noon. Candidates must report at 8:00 AM, and entry will close at 9:00 AM.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 1 2027 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Indian Air Force has released the detailed AFCAT 01/2027 notification covering Flying Branch, Ground Duty Technical, Ground Duty Non-Technical, NCC Special Entry and GATE Score Entry for courses commencing in January 2028. The 66-page notification contains branch-wise vacancies, age and educational qualifications, application procedures, examination syllabus, medical standards, selection stages, pay and allowances, training conditions and other instructions. Official Recruitment Website: AFCAT 01/2027 Notification

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 1 2027 Vacancy Details - 284 Posts
content_sections.text: The official notification provides separate vacancies for Flying Branch, Ground Duty Technical, Ground Duty Non-Technical and GATE Score Entry. NCC Special Entry seats are linked to the prescribed percentage of other Flying Branch vacancies. NCC Special Entry does not have a separate fixed-number vacancy allocation in the notification. Important: Vacancies are tentative and may change according to operational requirements, training capacity and availability of vacancies for January 2028 courses.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 1 2027 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must be Indian citizens and meet the prescribed educational, age, marital-status and medical requirements for their selected entry and branch. Candidates must have passed Mathematics and Physics at the 10+2 level and possess one of the following qualifications: Graduation of at least three years in any discipline from a recognized university. Four-year BE/B.Tech degree from a recognized university. Cleared Section A and B examinations of the Institution of Engineers (India) or Aeronautical Society of India, as prescribed. Important: Mathematics and Physics at the 10+2 level are mandatory for the Flying Branch. Candidates must also satisfy the applicable age and medical standards. Aeronautical Engineer (Electronics) candidates must have passed Physics and Mathematics at the 10+2 level and possess a recognized eligible engineering/technology qualification or one of the alternative qualifications specifically accepted in the notification. Eligible degree disciplines include various Electronics, Electrical, Electronics and Communication, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, Instrumentation, Robotics and related engineering specializations. The detailed notification also provides an alternative route involving M.Sc. Electronics with B.Sc. Physics and specified professional engineering examinations. Candidates must check the exact accepted discipline in Paragraph 5.3.2.1 before applying. Aeronautical Engineer (Mechanical) applicants must have passed Physics and Mathematics at the 10+2 level and completed a recognized four-year engineering/technology qualification or the specified equivalent professional examination route. Accepted engineering disciplines include Mechanical, Aeronautical, Aerospace, Automobile, Production, Industrial, Manufacturing, Mechatronics, Metallurgical and related specializations listed in the notification. Yes. Candidates studying in the final year or semester of their qualifying degree can apply if they have no current backlog when submitting their application. They must provide proof of completion of their final examinations by 30 November 2027 , under the conditions of the notification. No. The notification specifically states that candidates must have completed Class 12 under the 10+2 examination pattern. A diploma in place of 10+2 does not satisfy this condition.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 1 2027 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age eligibility is calculated as on 1 January 2028 , the scheduled course commencement period. Both dates in the specified date-of-birth ranges are inclusive. The Flying Branch relaxation up to 26 years applies only to candidates holding a valid and current Commercial Pilot Licence issued by DGCA (India). Candidates must be unmarried when the training course begins. Marriage is not permitted during training. Candidates who marry during training are liable to be discharged and required to refund Government expenditure incurred on their training.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 1 2027 Salary and Allowances
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be commissioned as Flying Officers and receive pay according to the Defence Pay Matrix. Applicable allowances may include Flying Allowance, Technical Allowance, Transport Allowance, Risk and Hardship Allowance and other authorized benefits. Salary Clarification: The training stipend and commissioned officer salary are different. Rs. 71,600 represents starting basic pay plus Military Service Pay, not the final in-hand salary.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 1 2027 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee for AFCAT Entry is Rs. 550 plus 18% GST , making a total of Rs. 649. Eligible candidates must make payment online through the payment gateway using the available Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking or UPI facilities. The application fee is non-refundable. Applicants should retain their payment reference number and transaction confirmation.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 1 2027 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection depends on the entry route. AFCAT Entry candidates must qualify in the written examination before AFSB testing, while NCC Special Entry candidates are exempt from the AFCAT written test. Online application and initial eligibility verification. AFCAT written examination for AFCAT Entry candidates. AFSB testing for shortlisted eligible candidates. Computerised Pilot Selection System (CPSS), where applicable to Flying Branch. Medical examination according to Indian Air Force standards. Final merit list based on the applicable entry and selection criteria. Branch allocation according to merit, medical fitness, vacancies and preferences. Training at the designated Air Force training establishment. The standard of Numerical Ability questions is Matriculation level, while the other subjects are generally of graduation level. The notification specifies 100 questions for 300 marks across the combined syllabus; it does not provide a fixed subject-wise question distribution.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 1 2027 AFSB Interview and Testing
content_sections.text: Candidates qualifying under the relevant entry route will be called for Air Force Selection Board (AFSB) testing. AFSB assessment involves Officer Intelligence Rating and psychological, group and interview assessments according to the prescribed testing stages. Flying Branch candidates may additionally be required to qualify in the Computerised Pilot Selection System (CPSS). Candidates who previously failed CPSS or were suspended from Flying Training at Air Force Academy are not eligible for the Flying Branch under the notification. Candidates recommended by AFSB must satisfy the prescribed Indian Air Force physical and medical standards. The requirements differ by Flying, Ground Duty Technical and Ground Duty Non-Technical branches. For Flying Branch training, the notification additionally requires a minimum nude body weight of 48 kg before commencing Stage-I fixed-wing flying training. Candidates should review the complete height, weight, vision and other medical standards contained in Appendix A of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT NCC Special Entry 2027
content_sections.text: NCC Special Entry provides eligible NCC Air Wing certificate holders an alternative route to Flying Branch selection. Applicants must possess an NCC Air Wing Senior Division 'C' Certificate acquired within the prescribed two-year period preceding the AFCAT registration date. Eligible NCC Special Entry candidates are exempt from the AFCAT written examination and are called directly for AFSB testing. They must still satisfy the educational, age, marital-status and medical requirements for Flying Branch.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT GATE Score Entry 2027
content_sections.text: GATE Score Entry is available for eligible Aeronautical Engineer (Electronics) and Aeronautical Engineer (Mechanical) candidates. Candidates must possess a completed BE/B.Tech qualification in one of the accepted engineering disciplines and qualify in the corresponding prescribed GATE subject. The GATE result declaration date must fall between 1 January 2024 and 31 December 2027 , as specified in the notification. Applicants must provide their GATE score details and supporting qualification records. The entry is subject to the applicable shortlisting and AFSB selection procedures.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT Permanent Commission and Short Service Commission
content_sections.text: The extension of Ground Duty SSC service is subject to vacancies, service requirements, willingness, merit and suitability. The notification also states that SSC officers are not entitled to pension under the applicable commission terms. Grant of Permanent Commission at a later date is not automatic.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 1 2027 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official AFCAT application portal between 12 November and 11 December 2026 . Apply Online: AFCAT Official Application Portal Application Start: 12 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. Last Date: 11 December 2026 at 11:30 PM. Important: Aadhaar details are mandatory for online registration. Applicants should verify their personal, educational and branch-preference information carefully before final submission because changes are not permitted after the applicable submission/payment stage.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for AFCAT 1 2027?
content_sections.text: Visit the official website afcat.edcil.co.in . Read the AFCAT 01/2027 notification and application instructions. Select the new registration or sign-up option. Enter your full name as recorded in the Class 10 certificate. Provide your mobile number and email address. Generate and verify the OTPs sent separately to the registered mobile number and email. Complete the required declaration and registration verification. Receive the Application Sequence Number/User ID and password. Log in and open the application form. Select the appropriate entry category: AFCAT, NCC Special Entry or GATE Score Entry. Enter personal information, date of birth, identification and contact details. Provide the required permanent and correspondence addresses. Enter Class 12, graduation and postgraduate qualification details, as applicable. Provide NCC, GATE, CPL or other special-entry information where required. Select eligible course and branch preferences. Choose the permitted examination city preferences. Upload the recent photograph, signature and thumb impression. Complete live image capture where requested by the portal. Review the application carefully. Submit the prescribed declarations. Pay the applicable application fee through the online gateway. Verify the successful payment and application submission status. Download and save the completed application form. Important: Candidates should complete the entire process before 11 December 2026 at 11:30 PM. Fees paid for additional or duplicate applications are not refundable.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 1 2027 Photograph and Document Upload Requirements
content_sections.text: The photograph should have a light background. Candidates must sign using black ink on white paper. Male applicants must upload their left-thumb impression, while female applicants must upload their right-thumb impression.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for AFCAT 1 2027
content_sections.text: Applicants should keep the following records ready for registration, examination and subsequent AFSB verification: Class 10 certificate for date-of-birth verification. Class 12 certificate and marksheet. Graduation or postgraduate qualification records, where applicable. Engineering degree certificate, where applicable. Recent passport-size photograph. Scanned signature and thumb impression. Aadhaar details. Valid photo identity documents. NCC Air Wing Senior Division 'C' certificate, if applicable. GATE scorecard and engineering records, if applicable. Valid DGCA Commercial Pilot Licence, if claiming the relevant concession. No Objection Certificate for Government/PSU employees, where required. Employer and educational documents required during AFSB testing. Downloaded AFCAT admit card. Other certificates specified by the official notification. Applicants should use their original academic records while entering details. Eligibility will be verified at subsequent selection stages.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 1 2027 Admit Card
content_sections.text: The Indian Air Force will make the AFCAT 01/2027 admit card available from 27 January 2027 at 11:00 AM . Candidates can log in to afcat.edcil.co.in and select the Download Admit Card option. The admit card will also be communicated electronically through the registered contact details as specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 1 2027 Training Details
content_sections.text: Training is scheduled to begin in the first week of January 2028. Flight Cadets will receive a fixed monthly stipend of Rs. 56,100 during training under the notified pay provisions.
